meta.title: Add a question in Form View

plan.title: Add a question in Form View

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow needed for an RFP technical stage.
Provide the mandatory event title before configuring the stage.
Create an RFP-only event so the technical questionnaire builder is available.
Work on the RFP stage where the Form View questions are configured.
Apply an available RFP template as the test setup.

args.goal: In the RFP template's Form View, click Add New Question, enter a question and description, choose a field type, set the Required toggle to either Yes or No, click the blue Add button, and stop on the section showing the new question with its entered description, field type, and required state.

steps.note: Perform the catalog-missing question-creation interaction and verify the saved question details on screen.
Confirm the question was saved without an application error.
